usage: 星期二 is used as a noun to refer to the day 'Tuesday' in a week.
It often appears in date expressions to specify when something will happen or happened.
In sentences, 星期二 can be the subject, object, or part of a time phrase.
It rarely takes plural form; the word itself implies a single day.
星期二 can be combined with verbs to describe actions or events occurring on that day.
